about: Answer key of the second invented case (lx-relevancetest A), written with the builder second_case.py before any load. Each entry: a planted fact, trap or decoy and the strings that carry it in the built bytes (paths relative to the build folder). Scoring aid only: never given to the agent, never read by product code.

entries.statement: Seven of the eight disputed refund checks (2201-2207) were endorsed for deposit to Nettlefield Savings account ending 7302 and appear as mobile deposits on Dorian Pell's statements.

entries.statement: Every disputed refund (R-1041 to R-1048) was approved under the login phalloran from workstation MGR-01, the practice manager's computer; Priya's computer is FRONT-1.
Priya was on approved leave from 11 to 22 March 2024; refunds R-1044, R-1045 and R-1046 were approved during it.
Priya's phone is at Lake Orrin, about 150 km away, every day of her leave, and her card paid Lake Orrin Cabins.
On 8 March Pell asked Priya to leave him her login on a sticky note 'to post the March refunds'; she said it was in the top drawer.

entries.statement: Pell transferred money to Teague Practice Services six times, days after each check deposit.

Quarrow Dental Supply, paid $4,600 a month by the practice, is a trading name of Teague Practice Services, registered to Marisol Teague at 14 Birchmoor Lane, Apt 2B, the address on its invoices; no delivery note exists.
On 25 April Pell told Marisol 'Brackley is asking about the refund log. delete the Quarrow emails'; his phone holds it as a deleted message.
None of the eight patients named on the disputed refunds is on the practice's patient roster.
Priya's own statements show payroll and ordinary spending only: no deposit of any refund check and no transfer to Pell or Teague.
Pell's interview claims contradict the records: 'Priya does every refund. I never touch the refund screen', 'I don't know anyone at Quarrow', 'never' used another login.

carriers.text: I never touch the refund screen

entries.statement: The complaint puts the loss at $18,640.00 in refund checks from January to April 2024 and accuses Priya because she handles refunds.
Pell's phone is at Marisol's flat (14 Birchmoor Lane) on the evening of each refund approval.
The practice's April statement arrives twice (bank production and Complainant's Exhibit B); its payments count once.
Paul Halloran is a real patient whose $85 refund (R-1049, check 2209, front desk FRONT-2) is legitimate; he is not Priya and not related to the disputed refunds.
Pell Hardware is a hardware shop the practice buys small items from; it is not Dorian Pell's business.
On 2 February Priya (12:10-12:22) and Pell (12:30) were both at Fennick Market, a busy grocery: a coincidence, not a meeting.
